title: He Saved His Enemy — Franz Stigler & Charlie Brown
description:
December 20, 1943: German fighter pilot Franz Stigler chose not to shoot down Charlie Brown’s damaged B-17. Decades later, the two became close friends.

Archival aircraft photographs illustrate the story; they are not photographs of the encounter.

"Reawakening"
